$comment: Record id prefixes that were retired in favour of another prefix. Every tool that writes registry ids (the SDK's normalizeRecordId, Genie, tools/seed-registry.mjs, the website's publish and submission routes) rewrites a retired prefix to its current one, so a renamed prefix can't come back. The registry keeps redirects from the old ids (0012_record_id_redirects.sql). Only add an entry together with a rename migration and redirects.
